_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is coiled with 30d momentum near 50 and no breaker; statistically honest default is HOLD inside Anxiety until momentum, funding, or fear_greed forces a rung change.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Anxiety and non-directional stance; narrative supplies no independent forward call beyond measured hold
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, 30d momentum near 50, fear_greed stuck 20s-30s through NFP
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum breaks under ~30 with deeply negative funding, or range breakout with fear_greed >45 and ETF flows positive
